reuse.why: The rule is added to the existing shouldFillCategory gate, which every month-wide action already uses, but the tag test is a hand-written regex instead of the tree's shared tag parser (extractTagsFromText in #shared/tags), and setZero keeps its own copy of the category query instead of reusing getAverageFillCategories.

duplication.why: The same `LEFT JOIN notes gn ON gn.id = g.id` / `gn.note AS group_notes` addition and the widened row type are pasted into three separate SQL queries (getBudgetData, getAverageFillCategories, setZero), two of which were already identical copies.

placement.why: The predicate sits next to hasSavedTemplates and is consulted from shouldFillCategory in the budget actions module, where the fill rules already live; the tag parsing itself would belong in shared/tags.

scope.why: Focused on the feature plus a test and release note, but it accidentally deletes the line of the doc comment that lists the existing exclusions, leaving a dangling blank line.

maintainability.why: The one gate is easy to follow, but the notes join is now maintained in three queries, and the private case-insensitive regex disagrees with how the rest of the app tokenises tags (case-sensitive, '#'-delimited, '##' escape).

bypasses_abstraction.where: isFixedGroup in server/budget/actions.ts uses its own regex instead of extractTagsFromText from #shared/tags; setZero repeats the category query instead of calling getAverageFillCategories

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated join/type additions are plain copies, not reshaped; the tag regex reimplements the shared tag parsing in a different form, but nothing is copied from it

one_place.where: The #fixed rule is checked once, in shouldFillCategory (via isFixedGroup), which copyPreviousMonth, setZero and the average-based actions all call; only the data feed (the notes join) is repeated in three queries
